decisions.reason: The About-page copy still states that each referral-free purchase creates six tickets, which conflicts with the new rule that each non-promotional mint contributes one ticket and one commission allocation.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The number of commissions and tickets should each equal the number of mints, excluding promotional mints. However, those distributed by weighted draw do not seem to be registering.

value_updates.no_referral_rewards_copy: State that each non-promotional referral-free purchase creates one ticket and one commission allocation, with both distributed by weighted draw.
